title: Roswell material as seed for an exotic alloy R&D program at Wright-Patterson
place_text: Air Force Research Lab, Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: The theory goes that whatever was recovered at Roswell eventually became a classified R&D seed program at Wright Patterson's Air Force Research Lab.

plain: Whatever was recovered from the reported 1947 crash at Roswell, New Mexico, is said to have become the seed of a secret research program at the Air Force Research Lab at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, working on exotic materials. Michels presents this himself as "the theory", without naming who holds it, in an episode about missing American scientists; if true, it would mean crash debris fed decades of hidden military research.
